# pi-tools-suite

Bundled Pi extensions for repository search, AST tools, sub-agents, todos,
context management and provider integrations.

The full [suite guide](https://github.com/dnaroid/pix/blob/master/wiki/tools/suite.md)
and [Pix Wiki](https://github.com/dnaroid/pix/blob/master/wiki/index.md)
are maintained in the Pix repository. In this checkout, open
[the local guide](../../wiki/tools/suite.md).

Runtime-loaded guides, role definitions and skill companions remain in this
package. [Plan-writing guidance](docs/plan-writing.md) is intentionally kept
at its installed path. Configuration: `~/.config/pi/pi-tools-suite.jsonc`,
`$PI_CONFIG_DIR/pi-tools-suite.jsonc`, then `<workspace>/.pi/pi-tools-suite.jsonc`.
